messages:
incident-bot: P0 — Sentra VPC: elevated 5xx errors detected on dedicated pool sentra-prod-pool (us-west-2). Error rate > 8% over 5m. Auto-fallback not triggered. Paging SRE on-call.
Priya (sre-oncall): Seeing it, joining bridge now. Thanks for the page.
Mateo (eng): Confirming spikes in model-serving logs, primarily KV cache misses followed by OOM retries on a subset of instances.
Priya (sre-oncall): Investigating pool instance health. Running quick check on GPU memory/driver.
Raman (infra): I'm seeing node churn — 3 nodes in the pool restarted by the hypervisor between 20:58–21:05 UTC. Could be flaky host.
ops-bot: Detected recent host maintenance on hw-cluster-12 in us-west-2 — maintenance window extended 2026-02-12 20:30–21:10 UTC (auto-resume).
Alyssa (prod): Sentra is on Dedicated Enterprise plan, high throughput. They reported timeouts to their app and are watching. Lia, Kevin — want us to call out customer impact?
Kevin (cs): Lia is on the customer bridge. Customer sees 5xx and request timeouts, some LLM sessions aborting. They've paused critical workflows. Escalating to Sentra's infra lead.
Lia (customer-success): On call with Sentra — they want an immediate mitigation and an exec note. Asking for ETA and whether we can failover them to a standby pool.
Priya (sre-oncall): Can we shift traffic to sentra-prod-pool-standby in another AZ? Raman — is cross-AZ routing safe right now?
Raman (infra): Standby pool is healthy, but model versions differ (v1.3 vs v1.4). We can failover to standby with auto-compat fallback; slight quality delta possible. Need approval for cross-AZ warmup (estimated 4–6m).
Mateo (eng): If we route, we should set request rate cap to avoid cold OOMs. Proposed route script: 
```
# cut traffic fast, limit concurrency
redwood route update --pool sentra-prod-pool --traffic 0 --drain 30s
redwood route update --pool sentra-prod-pool-standby --traffic 100 --concurrency 40
```
Priya (sre-oncall): I'll initiate controlled failover. Mateo, please standby to patch any model compatibility issues. Raman, please confirm network ACLs for Sentra VPC.
Raman (infra): ACLs good. Starting warmup now. Noted: cross-AZ latency +50ms.
Priya (sre-oncall): Failover in progress: stepping traffic over + monitoring for 5xx and latency.
incident-bot: Action log: failover initiated by Priya at 21:22 UTC.
Alyssa (prod): Lia — please tell Sentra we'll try the standby pool; possible minor model difference and latency bump. Kevin, can you draft short notice for them?
Kevin (cs): Drafting. Suggest: "We observed elevated errors in your dedicated pool due to host restarts. We are routing traffic to a healthy standby pool to restore service. You may see slight model behavior differences and an increase in latency ~+50ms while we stabilize. We will follow up with a post-incident update and any credits if SLA breached." Want to run by legal?
Lia (customer-success): On call with Sentra — they approved the failover. They're okay with temporary quality/latency changes.
Mateo (eng): 1m after failover: 5xx down to 0.9%, latency stableish. No model compatibility errors in logs so far.
Priya (sre-oncall): Marking incident mitigation success. Now starting post-mortem collection: host restart triggers, core dumps, driver logs, and pool autoscale history. Raman — pull hypervisor and hardware telemetry. Mateo — gather model-serving traces and recent deployments.
Raman (infra): Pulling from hw-cluster-12: syslogs, maintenance schedule, recent kernel updates. Found a kernel/kmod update applied 20:45 UTC that correlated with host reboots.
Mateo (eng): I see recent model config push 18:12 UTC but unrelated. No code deploys to the pool during event window.
Alyssa (prod): Can someone draft the executive summary for Sentra? Needs to include: what happened, immediate mitigation, customer impact, next steps, and timeline for RCA.
Priya (sre-oncall): I'll draft a technical RCA outline. Kevin/Lia — please craft the customer-facing exec note.
Kevin (cs): Draft v1 for Sentra execs: 
"Short summary: At 21:17 UTC we detected elevated error rates on your Dedicated Sentra pool due to several host restarts in our us-west-2 hardware cluster. We rerouted traffic to a healthy standby pool in another AZ and service was restored within ~5 minutes. Impact: some requests returned 5xx or timed out during the window; customers on heavy sessions may have experienced aborted sessions. Mitigation: controlled failover executed; longer-term: investigating host kernel update and will isolate affected hosts + provide credits if SLA breached. Next steps: full RCA within 48 hours with timeline for fixes and any credits. Contact: Kevin (Customer Success) / Priya (SRE)."
Lia (customer-success): Sentra asked for estimated credit if downtime > 99.9% SLA. We'll calculate after full span and include preliminary estimate in 48h.
Priya (sre-oncall): Post-incident tasks: Incident writeup, host patch rollback plan, blacklist affected hosts from prod for 24h, run soak on standby pool, verify auto-fallback rules. Assigning: Raman (host telemetry + patch), Mateo (serving traces + KV cache analysis), Alyssa (post-incident ops + deploying rollback), Kevin/Lia (customer comms).
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20260212-3518009876. Assigned to SRE, Infra, Eng, CS.
Priya (sre-oncall): Closing live mitigation. Will keep the thread open for RCA drafts and customer comms. Thanks all. :tada:
